answers.ask: What do players actually do out there - hunt each other, roleplay, or grind stats?
answers.answer: Players hunt and fight each other as animals and dinosaurs, earning progress to grind their stats and powers.

answers.ask: Should the stat upgrades happen at a place on the map, or through a menu?
answers.answer: Use a simple upgrade menu so players can spend their earned progress anywhere.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D game map set in a prehistoric wilderness where players appear as animals and dinosaurs, with open terrain suited to hunting and fighting.
agent_notes: Dinosaurs and animals with different powers hunting and fighting each other is the Roblox battlegrounds format, so Action leads and Battlegrounds is the preset - a bounded collision-clean clash space with risky edges, anti-camp spawns and pillars to break combat lock, themed as Jurassic dinosaurs rather than anime fighters. I did not name Simulation or RPG as a second genre even though stats are ground: the answers put the upgrades in a menu spendable anywhere, so the progression has no layout at all and there is no tier-ladder, no purchase gates and no P6 to import. Verticality is a style choice in this genre and the prompt only said a 3d map, so I kept the flat arena and left it on P0. The owner-only admin panel is UI rather than geometry, so nothing in the build expresses it.
